cards.signin: {{cast.user}} signs in to {{cast.company}} in the store's own page, driven through PingFederate's API.
cards.dcr: {{cast.agent}}, a shopping assistant, registers with {{cast.company}} using an initial access token; without it, no registration.
cards.rar: {{cast.agent}} asks to pay {{cast.payee}} for one basket, and {{cast.user}} approves that amount, nothing more.
cards.ciba: {{cast.agent}} found a deal but needs {{cast.user}}'s yes; PingFederate asks {{cast.user}} out of band.
cards.dpop: {{cast.agent}}'s token only works together with {{cast.agent}}'s private key.
cards.tokenExchange: {{cast.user}} delegates to {{cast.agent}}, which calls {{cast.serviceWord}}: the token carries the whole chain.
cards.userinfo: {{cast.agent}} reads {{cast.user}}'s profile from PingFederate with {{cast.user}}'s own token.
cards.piflow: {{cast.company}}'s checkout renders the sign-in steps from PingFederate's JSON.
cards.par: {{cast.agent}} pushes the order request to PingFederate before the user sees anything.
cards.pkce: The code that comes back to {{cast.agent}} only works with the verifier {{cast.agent}} kept.
